You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def pack(gi):
    import os,re,collections
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; comp=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in comp: continue
                    comp.add((a,b))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            x,y=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and gi[x][y]==gi[a][b] and (x,y) not in comp: st.append((x,y))
                mnr=min(r for r,_ in comp); mnk=min(c for _,c in comp)
                Mxr=max(r for r,_ in comp); Mxc=max(c for _,c in comp)
                rel={(r-mnr,c-mnk) for r,c in comp}
                sq = (Mxr-mnr+1)==2 and (Mxc-mnk+1)==2
                shape = rel - {(Mxr-mnr, Mxc-mnk)} if sq else rel
                comps.append((gi[i][j], shape, mnr, mnk, Mxr-mnr+1, Mxc-mnk+1))
    # sort by original left column
    comps.sort(key=lambda c:c[3])
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    occ=set()
    for k,(col,shape,mr,mc,h,w) in enumerate(comps):
        best=None
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                cells=[(r+a,c+b) for a,b in shape]
                if all(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W for rr,cc in cells) and not any((rr,cc) in occ for rr,cc in cells):
                    # score: as high and left as possible
                    key=(r,c)
                    if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,cells)
        r,c,_=best[0]; cells=best[1]
        for rr,cc in cells: res[rr][cc]=col; occ.update(cells)
    return res

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    comps=sorted(components(gi), key=lambda c:min(j for _,j in c[1]))
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cur_tl=(0,0)
    for k,(col,comp) in enumerate(comps):
        rs=[r for r,_ in comp]; cs=[c for _,c in comp]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        cells=[(r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in comp]
        if k!=len(comps)-1:
            cells=[p for p in cells if not (p[0]==h-1 and p[1]==w-1)]
        for a,b in cells: res[cur_tl[0]+a][cur_tl[1]+b]=col
        cur_tl=(cur_tl[0]+h, cur_tl[1]+w)  # BR of full bbox = next TL
    return res
for n in (1,2):
    r=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])
    print(n, r==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    if r!=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']:
        show(r); print('vs'); show(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out)); show(out)

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cs=sorted(comps_of(gi), key=lambda c:min(j for _,j in c[1]))
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cur_tl=(0,0); prev_br=None; n=len(cs)
    for k,(col,comp) in enumerate(cs):
        rs=[r for r,_ in comp]; cc2=[c for _,c in comp]

        t = cur_tl if k==0 else prev_br
        for r,c in comp:

            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: res[rr][cc]=col
        prev_br=(t[0]+hh-1, t[1]+ww-1)
    return res

    return res

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cs=comps_of(gi)
    # dedupe: keep unique bbox+shape per color occurrence (sort by min col)
    items=[]
    for col,comp in cs:
        rs=[r for r,_ in comp]; cc=[c for _,c in comp]
        hh=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; ww=max(cc)-min(cc)+1
        cells=frozenset((r-min(rs),c-min(cc)) for r,c in comp)
        items.append((min(cc),col,cells,hh,ww))
    items.sort()
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    tl=(0,0); n=len(items)
    for k,(_,col,cells,hh,ww) in enumerate(items):
        t=tl if k==0 else tl_prev
        # drop BR unless last piece
        if k!=n-1: cells={(a,b) for a,b in cells if not(a==hh-1 and b==ww-1)}
        for a,b in cells:
            rr,cc=t[0]+a,t[1]+b
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: res[rr][cc]=col
        tl_prev=(t[0]+hh-1,t[1]+ww-1)
    return res
for n in (1,2):
    print(n, f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
out=f(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(out)); show(out)

# Proper version: track per-piece dims; next TL = prev absolute BR (using prev piece's final shape extents)
def f(gi):
    Hh,Ww=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    seen=set(); lst=[]
    for c in comps_of(gi):
        cc_,mr,mc,cells,hh,ww = c
        rel=frozenset(cells)
        if (cc_, rel) not in seen:
            seen.add((cc_, rel)); lst.append((rel,hh,ww,cc_,mr,mc))
    lst.sort(key=lambda x:(x[4],x[5]))
    res=[[0]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]
    n=len(lst); cur_tl=(0,0); prev_ext=None
    for k,(shape,hh,ww,col,_,_) in enumerate(lst):
        # grow height by 1 for first piece
        h2 = hh + (1 if k==0 else 0)
        s = shape if k==n-1 else frozenset(p for p in shape if p!=(hh-1,ww-1))
        if k==0:
            t=cur_tl
        else:
            # prev piece's absolute BR = prev tl + (prev_ext)
            ph, pw = prev_ext
            t=(cur_tl[0]+ph, cur_tl[1]+pw)
        for a,b in s:
            rr,cc=t[0]+a,t[1]+b
            if 0<=rr<Hh and 0<=cc<Ww: res[rr][cc]=col
        cur_tl=(t[0]+max(a for a,_ in s), t[1]+max(b for _,b in s))
        prev_ext=(h2-1, ww-1)
    return res

def f(gi):
    cs=comps(gi)
    cs.sort(key=lambda c:min(b for _,b in c[2]))
    res=[[0]*len(gi[0]) for _ in range(len(gi))]
    prev_br=(-1,-1)
    for c in cs:
        col,_,cells=c
        h=max(a for a,_ in cells)+1; w=max(b for _,b in cells)+1
        t=(prev_br[0]+1, max(prev_br[1], prev_br[0]-h)) if False else None
        # TL = (prev BR row +1, prev BR col), clamped so first piece sits at row 0
        if prev_br==(-1,-1): t=(0,0)
        else: t=(prev_br[0]+1, prev_br[1])
        for a,b in cells:
            rr,cc=t[0]+a,t[1]+b
            if 0<=rr<len(res) and 0<=cc<len(res[0]): res[rr][cc]=col
        prev_br=(t[0]+h-1, t[1]+w-1)
    return res

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cs=comps_of(gi)
    cs.sort(key=lambda c:min(b for _,b in c[1]))
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cur_br=(-1,-1)
    for k,c in enumerate(cs):
        col,cells=c
        h=max(a for a,_ in cells)+1; w=max(b for _,b in cells)+1
        if k==len(cs)-1: s=set(cells)
        else: s={(a,b) for a,b in cells if (a,b)!=(h-1,w-1)}
        t=(cur_br[0]+1,cur_br[1])
        # keep within bounds: use only in-bounds cells
        cells_in=[(a,b) for a,b in s if 0<=t[0]+a<H and 0<=t[1]+b<W]
        if cells_in:
            for a,b in cells_in: res[t[0]+a][t[1]+b]=col
            cur_br=(max(t[0]+a for a,_ in cells_in)-0 or t[0]+h-1,t[1]+w-1)
    return res

def solve(gi):
    cs=comps_of(gi); cs.sort(key=lambda co:min(b for _,b in co[1]))
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    br=(-1,-1)  # last piece's actual bottom-right cell
    for k,(col,cells) in enumerate(cs):
        rmin=min(a for a,_ in cells); cmin=min(b for _,b in cells)
        h=max(a for a,_ in cells)-rmin+1; w=max(b for _,b in cells)-cmin+1
        s=frozenset(cells) if k==len(cs)-1 else {(a,b) for a,b in cells if not(a-rmin==h-1 and b-cmin==w-1)}
        tl=(br[0]+1, br[1]+1) if k>0 else (0,0)
        for a,b in s:
            rr,cc=tl[0]+(a-rmin), tl[1]+(b-cmin)
            res[rr][cc]=col
        br=(max(a for a,_ in cells), max(b for _,b in cells))
    return res
print(solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'], solve(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cs=comps_of(gi); cs.sort(key=lambda co:min(b for _,b in co[1]))
    br=(-1,-1)  # last piece's occupied bottom-right
    for k,(col,cells) in enumerate(cs):
        rmin=min(a for a,_ in cells); cmin=min(b for _,b in cells)
        h=max(a for a,_ in cells)-rmin+1; w=max(b for _,b in cells)-cmin+1
        if k==len(cs)-1: s={(a-rmin,b-cmin) for a,b in cells}
        else: s={(a-rmin,b-cmin) for a,b in cells if not(a-rmin==h-1 and b-cmin==w-1)}
        tl=(br[0]+1, br[1]+1) if k>0 else (0,0)
        for a,b in s:
            rr,cc=tl[0]+a, tl[1]+b

        br=(max(a for a,_ in [(rmin+max(x for x,_ in s),0)],default=-1), max(b for _,b in s)) if s else br
    return res
